data.one_liner: Plugin to open files via native apps, returning a string result
data.what_it_does: open_filex lets a Flutter app launch the appropriate native application to open a file and returns the result as a string. It supports iOS, Android, desktop (via ffi) and web.
use_when: You need to open a file with the default system app
You want a simple cross‑platform solution without writing platform code
You need to get a result string from the opened app
avoid_when: You need to edit or read the file contents within Flutter
You require fine‑grained file handling or custom file pickers
strengths: No extra dependencies beyond flutter and ffi
Handles platform‑specific permissions and FileProvider setup
weaknesses: iOS deployment target must be 13.0 or higher
No built‑in file picking or editing features
data.setup_notes: Add Android FileProvider XML and manifest entries; bump iOS deployment target to 13.0; no build_runner needed
